mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to its 20-year median compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 20-year median, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS above 12-month average) and declining unemployment (UNRATE below 12-month average) signals robust labor market conditions that drive positive equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the joint labor market condition, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion (HOUST above 12-month average) indicates strengthening consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns during early-cycle expansion regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 12mo avg, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 100.0) signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply-side slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST above 12-month average) and retail sales (RSAFS above 12-month average) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the joint demand condition, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPI (CPIAUCSL above 300.0) signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger aggressive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 300.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates tight labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling periods.
